book.title: REVARESION Jon Gumbe Iesu Keriso Taibe Toyau Nunnewa

content: Areruya!
Dividivi mame onananewa, kwimin danave iyayapan agonagon kokavit ayawa nouwa mina veme ne anona,

content.text: Waita ge eyawa ge yusiwa God numa meuma.
God keptete meuma me natawa ge oraimina.
Me uinantaraki vesinawa kokawa ibnawa wanne.
Vesin me uinantaraki meuma gumbe piyu wakukamne.
Sira God me nau meuma eme igiyawa ganigani muma oya garawa vesin gumbe ane.”

content: Mu sira waya,
Koukawa igiyawa 24 ge vinemewa 4 mu God wakeivi arawa namive konuwa yug waiyaya. Mu waya,
God wakeiviwa arawa apa noiwa uwag waivi,

content.text: “God nauwawa eme igiyawa ye undag God numa waiyaya.
me gumbe a anewa ye undag God waiyaya!”

content: Iyayapan agonagon ayawa nouwa mina, yoi koka noiwa mina, aeg koka noiwa mina, me wane anona,

content.text: Kuiyawa Ayapan God Yusipamitwa numa me dividivi undag amaraivi.
Kuiyawa Sip Usiwa memgebip kumiwa uwane.
Wape rinen me esinewa ge miyot onan. Biviwa me entan oya wanne.

content: Wape me oraiwa me iyakaisi igiyawa oraivit ayawa.”
Aneya gunap wane, “Teya. Sip Usiwa memgebip nakwaeba oya munan auwanewa mu waribiya munne. Sira me gunap wane, “Gae mame natawa, me God gaiyawa.”

Me kumive, ne me waiyatan oya amave koninwa yuna. Me gunap wane, “Den a. Ne ge mina sira tatagaiwa mina nau meuma eniwa. Ne mina Iesu oya taibe watanwa abnawa yumnadna. God waiyaigima. Kuiyawa Iesu oya taibe watanwa me propeta guwawa meuma.”
Mae Osi Pupuyu Egave Dauwanewa
Ne kwimin watabne yauna. Yawa. Mae osi pupuyu wakene. Me egave wakeiviwa me nau meuma gumbe aug aiviwa ge natawa veme. Sira me keptete oraivit ag mut ape.
Me yangawa iyam meru mina igivi. Kin keretawa obiren kuiyave tonadne. Me iviwa mu gumbo tene. Me iviwa bira da den yaug anoya, go me membovit yaug anone.
Me wape ganigani gumbe emnewa enne. Me iviwa God gaiyawa.
Mut igiyawa kwiminau mae osi pupuyu egave wakeg me amave amome. Mu wape pupuyu ge miyot onan wapeyawa eniya.
Deba donapam me noive dauwaivi. Me gumbe me at kokawa igiyawa obiren gutpe. Sira me tutuwawa aiyan gumbe amaramumpe. Me wain amave emnewa empe. Wain amave emnewa me God Yusipamitwa danapiri meuma.
Wape meuma egave sira me maunawa egave me iviwa tene. Iviwa meib tene, Kin Painauvitwa, me Ayapan Painauvitwa.
Sira ne aneya desirom kum danave yokeivine yauna. Me noiwa wansin nenip undag gumbo kwaruwane. Nenip mu piyu kwimin yapave vereg gigeme. Me wane, “Oneya. God nakwaeba kokawa oya agoniyaya.

Kin kwapuwa, mut namu yoiyoi igiyawa kwapuwa, yutuatatu kwapuwa, mae osi kwapuwa, mae osi egave amomewa kwapuwa, sira ui onan igiyawa ge ankwatave nau eme igiyawa undag kwapuwa, iyayapan kusikusiwa ge koukawa undag kwapuwa, ye naya.”
Sira ne mae yusiatatuwa, piyu kin muma ge mut igiyawa mumawa agoniyag toboraya yawamna. Mut igiyawa muma mae osi egave wakeiviwa ge mut igiyawa meumawa gumbo mut eme yawamna.

Mae yusiatatu yumne. Me gaibu propeta ugaugaeba yumamne. Propeta ugaugaeba me mae yusiatatu namive irayauyau ane. Irayauyau meuma gumbe iyayapan ugai mun mae yusiatatu irawa kusi auya. Sira propeta ugaugaeba iyayapan ugai mun mae yusiatatu guwawa waiyaya. Propeta ugaugaeba me gaibu yumamne. Duwam mu ande kaninga kondowin iyam igiviwa danave emeya. Me danave sarupa
igivi.
Iyayapan upeba deba gumbe gudne boriruwaya. Deba me mae osi egave wakeiviwa noive dauwaivi. Sira nenip undag mu kwapuwa naya oma ane.
